card.name: Yoga meditation definition passage
card.fires_on: Words inside one repeated passage defining Meditation as one of the Five Principles of Yoga, such as 'observation of the mind' and 'perceive the self'. It fires on ordinary linking words there, not on specific terms.

modes.label: Linking words in the definition
modes.description: Small words in the sentence about constant observation of the mind.
modes.example: It is the practice by which there is constant observation of<< the>> mind.

modes.label: Later sentences of the passage
modes.description: Words in the follow-on lines about focusing the mind and perceiving the self.
modes.example: you will achieve<< a>> greater sense of purpose and strength of will

card.plain: It reacts to one specific yoga and meditation text that appears repeatedly, not to a general idea.
